environment.description: Same application deployed identically but the EC2 instance runs within a VPC whose subnet route table has no internet gateway route (egress only via NAT for package updates). Access is exclusively through AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a VPC Link to a Network Load Balancer. The API Gateway resource /api/users/search has a request validator enabled with a mapping template that applies URL-decoding normalization and then enforces a regex constraint on the 'q' query string parameter: pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9@.\-_ ]{0,64}$ (validated server-side by API Gateway before forwarding). Additionally, the API Gateway has a usage plan with throttling (10 req/s burst, 5 req/s sustained) and requires an x-api-key header tied to a registered client. The method request parameters define 'q' and 'field' as required with the caching TTL of 0 (no caching, just validation).

api_gateway.request_validator: Validate query string parameters and headers

network.nlb: internal, target group pointing to app on port 8080
